configurable_props.name: dataSourceId
configurable_props.label: Data Source ID
configurable_props.description: Select a data source or provide a data source ID

configurable_props.name: title
configurable_props.label: Title
configurable_props.description: Title of the data source as it appears in Notion. An array of [rich text objects](https://developers.notion.com/reference/rich-text).

configurable_props.name: description
configurable_props.label: Description
configurable_props.description: An array of [rich text objects](https://developers.notion.com/reference/rich-text) that represents the description of the data source that is displayed in the Notion UI. If omitted, then the data source description remains unchanged.

configurable_props.name: properties
configurable_props.label: Properties
configurable_props.description: The properties of a data source to be changed in the request, in the form of a JSON object. If updating an existing property, then the keys are the names or IDs of the properties as they appear in Notion, and the values are [property schema objects](https://developers.notion.com/reference/property-schema-object). If adding a new property, then the key is the name of the new data source property and the value is a [property schema object](https://developers.notion.com/reference/property-schema-object).
